digest.component_or_area: CLI help generation and discovery system
propositions: Pure-intercept routes must appear exactly once in overview help unless explicitly omitted (help, bridge-fsck, bridge-probe)
rebar help <command> and rebar <command> --help must both return committed artifact bytes matching generated help for all visible routes

Child parsers (identity create, identity use, identity key, config validate) must return child usage via parser-introspective or handler-dispatched help without mounting ticket store or executing handlers
Help discovery predicate must be exactly `not route.hidden and not route.retired` across all four census sites without adding route metadata
CLI generators must consume committed-byte artifacts and preserve multiline usage formatting (trusted-env) via unwrapping logic gated on `parser.usage is None`

Model-backed CLI operations (review-code, review-plan, scan-spec, verify-completion) require reason-bearing exemptions in driver classification and offline schema validation for config and sign-review
